simple.meaning: בֹּשֶׁת (bôsheth) appears 31 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with kingship and in connection with priesthood. The surrounding account also brings the name into death.

definitions.short: shame (the feeling and the condition, as well as its cause); by implication (specifically) an idol
definitions.usage: ashamed, confusion, greatly, (put to) shame(-ful thing).
